definition: Phalcon is a PHP web framework implemented in part as a native extension.
entry_text: Phalcon is a PHP web framework implemented in part as a native extension.
example: A developer uses its routing and model components to build a database-backed web application.
label: Phalcon

sources.note: The official project identifies Phalcon as a full-stack PHP web framework distributed as a native C extension; this is more precise than the draft's in-part implementation wording.
